cover.title: Ukulele Orchestra of Great Britain
cover.calloutLabel: A note from CEO of Vivo Performing Arts
cover.pressQuote: "A joyful collision of musical pyrotechnics and deadpan British wit—the Ukulele Orchestra of Great Britain remains irresistible." The Guardian

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Small but mighty, the "Ukes" are a tour-de-force of strings worthy of any musical wish list—jaw- dropping musical virtuosity on four types of ukuleles paired with humor ranging from bone-dry to almost slapstick. An evening of joy and musicianship that expands horizons and warms the soul.
body: Small but mighty, the "Ukes" are a tour-de-force of strings worthy of any musical wish list. Treat yourself to a blend of jaw-dropping musical virtuosity (on four types of ukuleles) and humor that ranges from bone-dry to almost slapstick. Delightfully versatile, they'll perform anything and everything: classic rock, TV theme songs, classical music, and so much more. It's an evening of joy and musicianship that expands horizons and warms the soul.
